assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a quiet hand-painted birthday puzzle game. Input image 1 supplies fine wood/brass material; image 2 supplies the PRIMARY soft pencil/watercolor picturebook linework, pale sage/ivory palette and gentle sunlight. Draw three separate COMPLETE objects on a transparent 1536x1024 canvas, no backdrop: (A) in left 1024x1024 region, a handsome compact pale-sage and honey-wood record player viewed DIRECTLY FROM ABOVE, full rectangular body, fine pencil edges and subtle wood grain, soft contact shadow. It has an EMPTY circular charcoal felt platter on the left half, a small spindle centered in it, and an empty tonearm pivot mounting on the upper-right. No vinyl disc and NO ARM attached to the main body; these will be independently animated. Very restrained brass details, one small blank label area at lower edge, no knobs or extra fake controls. Leave good margins. (B) in upper-right 512x512 region, one perfectly ROUND charcoal-brown vinyl record viewed from above, delicate circular grooves and a small pale warm paper center label with a tiny hand-drawn star, no lettering, complete safe outer edge. (C) in lower-right 512x512 region, one complete slender brass tonearm viewed from above, pivot on its upper-left, light bent tube extending to a small ivory needle cartridge at lower-right, same scale/style as the player. It will rotate about the pivot. Keep the three assets visually separated with clear transparent space. Elegant restrained handmade drawing, not glossy3D or photoreal product shot. No extra objects, flowers, characters, scenery, UI, text, typography, fake glyphs, framing or watermark. Truly transparent alpha outside objects.
assets.edit: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a sprite atlas for an interactive game. Keep the transparent canvas dimensions, arrangement, record at upper-right, detached complete tonearm at lower-right, player body, empty felt platter, color, pencil lines and wood texture unchanged. Change ONLY the fixed brass tonearm mounting assembly on the upper-right area of the large LEFT player body: remove the entire raised cylinder, large round base and the short little brass stub/lever, filling that area seamlessly with the same pale sage-green panel. Leave only a very small flat brass alignment dot at the exact former pivot center, around x=818,y=300 in the 1536x1024 atlas. The separate full tonearm will cover this dot in the game, so absolutely no fixed arm/stub/cylinder may remain painted on the player. Everything else is invariant. Preserve true transparency, whole unclipped objects, safe space between the three sprites. No new text or objects.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a transparent sprite atlas of FOUR SEPARATE complete paper components for an interactive birthday invitation in a quiet picturebook puzzle game. The reference is the PRIMARY style: soft fine pencil outlines, pale ivory paper, restrained honey and sage accents, subtle watercolor texture in warm daylight. No photorealism, glossy 3D, hard digital gradients or UI mockup. Canvas 1536x1024 with generous clear transparent margins, four quadrants 768x512, no touching or overlap. All components viewed straight from above with matching width and alignment, no perspective tilt. (A) top-left: one simple rectangular BACK BOARD of a cream paper envelope, approximately650x350 pixels, landscape, gently rounded handmade corners, subtle inner paper surface and a very light contact shadow. It must be a FULL plain rectangle, NO flap, NO front pocket, NO writing or card inside. (B) top-right: the FRONT POCKET layer of that same envelope at exactly the same650x350 scale, complete bottom and sides, a shallow V-shaped opening along the upper edge showing TRANSPARENCY above the V; the two side wings taper down to center, delicate diagonal fold lines, lower part solid ivory paper. No back board behind the V; this layer will cover a separately animated letter. (C) bottom-left: just the matching single TRIANGULAR CLOSING FLAP, horizontal straight hinge at top, tip pointing DOWN, about650x220 pixels, full separate triangle with fine fold edge and softly lit ivory paper; NO envelope behind it, NO wax seal. (D) bottom-right: one COMPLETE flat blank cream invitation card, landscape520x390 pixels, softly irregular paper edge, a very faint sage pencil rule near its border and a tiny restrained pressed leaf in ONE corner, substantial completely empty middle. No envelope, no words. Style and paper color must match all four. All components flat as rigid paper cutouts, consistent lineweight and shadow direction; suitable for smooth independent layer animation. Absolutely no text, symbols, letters, numbers, hands, characters, scenes, frames, labels or watermark. True transparent alpha everywhere outside the four individual parts.
assets.registration: Back, pocket, flap and card are complete alpha sprites; local frames in asset-layouts. The first card size leaked below the envelope; accepted card is70% of body width. Paper flip uses actual front/reverse faces with inert semantics.
